title: Known-object test, TOI-6614.01
summary: Known-object test on TOI-6614.01: positive control on the catalogued transit(s), calibrated screen for further dips, catalogue cross-match. Runner: Calibration on each light curve (sign-flip null, injection–recovery): k* 3, 3, 3, 3, ≤2.5, 3; at the declared k = 5 the screen recovers ≥90% of 4-h dips only from depth none on grid, 2%, none on grid, none on grid, none on grid, none on grid (completeness for 2000 ppm: 0%, 0%, 0%, 0%, 0%, 0%). The null result excludes only dips deeper than that. Positive control: catalogued transit gap, partial, recovered (6 covered epochs). Residual screen: 47 threshold entries outside the known-signal veto across 6 light curve(s), forming 15 distinct event(s), 6 persistent in SAP and PDCSAP at two or more baselines. Repeat candidate: a persistent event matching the catalogued depth at BJD 2460906.8159 (ΔT 179.59 d); 2 period aliases remain. Unverified lead until vetted.
